summary.text: Travis Corcoran is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 28 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning a software startup and working as an author.

paragraphs.text: Travis Corcoran earned a degree in computer science and history from Cornell University in 1993.
His career experience includes owning a software startup and working as an author.
Corcoran won election to the New Hampshire House in 2022 from Hillsborough 44, and won re-election in Hillsborough 28 in 2024.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Fish and Game and Marine Resources Committee.
In 2026 he is one of two incumbent Republicans on the general election ballot in the two-seat district, alongside Keith Erf, and Democrats David Erikson and Benson Goodwin are also running.

On May 21, 2026, the New Hampshire House voted 288 to 54 to censure Corcoran over two social media posts he made in March about other lawmakers; Corcoran said in a floor speech that he had not apologized and would not, because he had "done nothing wrong."
